title: LEMON SAUCE
instructions: --Mix three tablespoons of corn starch with one cup of cold water and turn on one cup of boiling water. Boil ten minutes, then add one cup of sugar, the juice and grated yellow rind of one lemon and two rounding tablespoons of butter.
